_note: Sound effects, made with ElevenLabs text to sound v3 by `npm run sfx`. The scenes place them on visible actions (cursor clicks, typing, the hand-drawn underlines (a soft mallet note), section cards). volume is the playback level in the mix, kept low so the narration stays in front. Edit a prompt, then run `npm run sfx` (only changed sounds are regenerated) and `npm run build`.

click-1.prompt: A single soft, clean computer mouse click, close and dry, no room sound

click-2.prompt: One quiet trackpad click, crisp and gentle, dry studio recording

typing.prompt: A few quick, soft keystrokes on a modern laptop keyboard, light and quiet, dry

underline.prompt: A single soft, warm felt-mallet marimba note, mellow and gentle, short and quiet, no echo

whoosh.prompt: A very soft, airy whoosh for a gentle slide transition, smooth and subtle, no impact
